text: This report submits the draft 2020 financial statements for approval. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the financial statements on 2021-05-13 and recommended it for approval by the Board.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the draft Financial Statements of the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo for the year ended December 31, 2020 as attached in Attachment 1 to the report (May 25, 2021) from the Director, Finance and Technology, Toronto Zoo.
